scope: native v5 shutdown dispatch and callback admission
verified_behaviors: v5 shutdown closes admission before its registry transaction and provider callback
live ApplicationConnection and FileService owners make shutdown return EBUSY without invoking the shutdown provider
application and service provider Close callbacks run before their admission and OS lease owners drop
forced ApplicationConnection allocation failure closes the provider context exactly once and Close reenters production topology_query with result 73
pre-effect callback errors restore registry state and only reopen a gate closed by that attempt
successful shutdown retains a closed gate across NotBooted and failed reboot cleanup; successful boot reopens after Ready
v1 through v4 ABI signatures and exports remain present
preserved_failure_families: initial v5 dispatch lacked callback admission
failed reboot could strand a newly closed admission gate
application Open and topology callbacks temporarily lost legacy serialization
fallible ApplicationConnection allocation could invoke reentrant Close while holding the operation mutex
excluded: SMP provider wiring or production ABI build
guest CPU stop acknowledgement or parking
worker, channel, mapping or resource retirement
kernel module, container, privileged or guest execution
SC-LIFE-02 verification, production gate credit or whole-OS acceptance
